title: Kai and the Lost Library Book
subtitle: A neighbourhood mystery solved with careful clues
summary: With Aunt Jo’s help, Kai retraces a rainy-day walk and finds a library book with help from a familiar neighbour.

cover.narration: Kai and the Lost Library Book

pages.title: A Rainy-Day Book
pages.text: Kai chose a picture book from the library for a rainy afternoon. Aunt Jo checked it out, and Kai tucked it safely into a blue tote bag before walking home.
pages.imagePrompt: Inside a bright neighbourhood library, Aunt Jo hands Kai a colourful picture book at the desk. Kai places it into a blue tote bag while rain falls beyond the window. Avoid readable cover or signage text.

pages.title: An Empty Bag
pages.text: At home, Kai opened the tote bag, but the book was missing. Kai felt worried. Aunt Jo was still at the library, so Kai called her with Dad nearby.
pages.imagePrompt: At home by the door, Kai looks into an empty blue tote bag with a worried face. Dad stands close by, calm and supportive, as Kai uses a phone to call Aunt Jo. No readable screen text.

pages.title: Three Stops
pages.text: Aunt Jo listened kindly on the phone. She helped Kai remember three stops: the bakery, the bus shelter and the library gate. Dad offered to retrace the walk together.
pages.imagePrompt: Kai and Dad stand by a simple neighbourhood map with three picture-like landmarks: bakery, covered bus shelter, library gate. Aunt Jo appears on a phone call. Do not show words, route labels or personal details.

pages.title: The Bakery
pages.text: At the bakery, Elsie remembered Kai’s yellow umbrella. She had not seen the book inside, but she pointed out the dry pavement leading toward the bus shelter.
pages.imagePrompt: Outside a cosy bakery on a rainy street, Elsie speaks with Kai and Dad beneath the shop awning. Kai’s yellow umbrella is clear. The covered bus shelter is visible farther along the pavement.

pages.title: A Familiar Neighbour
pages.text: At the covered bus shelter, Noor was locking a red bicycle. Noor knew Kai from the neighbourhood and had noticed a blue book beside the dry bench.
pages.imagePrompt: At a well-lit covered bus shelter, familiar neighbour Noor locks a red bicycle beside a dry bench. Noor points from a safe distance toward a blue book resting beside the bench. Kai and Dad approach together.

pages.title: The Blue Cover
pages.text: Kai checked the cover. It was the library book! It had stayed dry beside the sheltered bench. Kai thanked Noor and held the book carefully against the raincoat.
pages.imagePrompt: Kai confirms the blue book is the same picture book, comparing its colourful illustration with a small library stamp shown without readable words. The book is dry beside the sheltered bench; Dad remains beside Kai.

pages.title: Back to the Library
pages.text: Kai and Dad walked back to the library together. Aunt Jo welcomed them at the door. Kai explained where the book had been and checked that its pages were dry.
pages.imagePrompt: Kai and Dad return to the library entrance, where Aunt Jo welcomes them. Kai holds the dry book open to check the pages. Show the rainy street outside and a warm bright interior.

pages.title: A Helpful Slot
pages.text: Aunt Jo showed Kai the library return slot. Kai slid the book through carefully, and Aunt Jo checked it back in. Kai felt relieved to have solved the mystery.
pages.imagePrompt: At the library’s interior return desk, Aunt Jo demonstrates a safe return slot while Kai places the book inside. Make the action clear and friendly, with no readable labels or signage.

pages.title: One More Clue
pages.text: Aunt Jo asked Kai what helped. Kai remembered the bakery, the covered bench and Noor’s careful eyes. Dad smiled at the useful clues they had followed together.
pages.imagePrompt: Kai, Dad and Aunt Jo talk beside the library desk. In the background through a window are small glimpses of the bakery and bus shelter. Kai counts three clues on their fingers.

pages.title: A Zipped Pocket
pages.text: Kai borrowed another picture book and placed it in a zipped pocket inside the tote bag. Then Kai and Dad walked home beneath the yellow umbrella, feeling ready for the next rainy day.
pages.imagePrompt: Kai and Dad walk home together under the yellow umbrella. A new picture book is visible safely inside a zipped tote pocket. The library glows behind them; a calm, cosy rainy-day ending.
